item.title: Emerging Markets Review - African Financial Research
item.content:encoded:
This call invites research proposals focused on African financial markets and emerging markets research. The journal seeks high-quality submissions that advance our understanding of financial phenomena in African contexts and emerging market economies.

Potential topics

  • African financial markets
  • Emerging markets research
  • Financial economics in Africa

Timeline

  • May 30, 2027: Submission deadline

item.title: African Financial Research Proposals
item.content:encoded:
This call invites research proposals focusing on financial research topics relevant to African economies and financial systems. The special issue seeks to advance understanding of financial dynamics, institutions, and markets across the African continent.

Potential topics

  • Financial markets and institutions in Africa
  • Banking sector development and regulation
  • Capital markets and investment in African economies
  • Corporate finance and governance in African firms
  • Financial inclusion and access to finance in Africa
  • Macroeconomic finance and monetary policy in African countries
  • Risk management and financial stability in African financial systems
  • Fintech and digital finance innovation in Africa
  • International trade finance and currency markets in Africa
  • Real estate and infrastructure finance in Africa

Timeline

  • May 30, 2027: Submission deadline

item.title: Finance Research Letters - African Research Proposals
item.content:encoded:
This call for papers invites research proposals focused on African finance and financial systems. We are interested in original research that advances our understanding of financial markets, institutions, and practices across the African continent.

Submissions should present novel findings and insights relevant to African financial contexts, including studies on market structures, regulatory frameworks, institutional development, and financial behavior in African nations and regions.

Potential topics

  • African financial markets and institutions
  • International finance and development in Africa
  • Corporate finance in African companies
  • Risk management in African financial systems
  • Financial innovation and technology in Africa
  • Economic development and finance in African countries

Timeline

  • December 31, 2023: Submission deadline for research proposals
